values.binNote: Bin's ZoneDamageTooltip = (MaxHealthDamage[2/3/4] + 0.005xap) * 0.05, i.e. (2..4)% + 0.025%*ap of max HP, matching wiki's 10 to 20% (=2..4 * 5 ticks) and 2.5% per 100 AP; this value here is the 5-tick total.

values.quote: dealing them magic damage every {{fd|0.25}} seconds
values.binNote: No bin row states the 0.25s tether tick interval directly; it is implied by BeamDamageTicks=10 over SuppressDuration=2.5, but no field names the interval itself.

values.quote: dealing magic damage every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within
values.binNote: No bin field names the Null Zone's 0.5s tick interval directly; the tooltip's *0.05 factor (=0.5s/5s*0.5 ticks-count logic) implies 10 ticks over ZoneDuration=5, matching 0.5s, but no row states the interval itself.

mechanics.claim: Malzahar tethers to the target, knocking them down, then channels for up to 2.5 seconds, suppressing and revealing the target and dealing damage every 0.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Malzahar tethers to the target enemy champion, knocking them down. He then channels for up to 2.5 seconds, suppressing and revealing the target and dealing them magic damage every 0.25 seconds

mechanics.claim: Malzahar continues channeling as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.
mechanics.quote: Malzahar will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.

mechanics.claim: A Null Zone is opened at the target's location at time of cast, lasting 5 seconds and dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies within it, capped at 120 per tick against minions/monsters.
mechanics.quote: a Null Zone is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against minions and monsters.

mechanics.claim: The Null Zone persists even if the channel is interrupted.
mechanics.quote: Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.

mechanics.claim: As long as the target stays within tether radius, they take the full tether damage over 2.5 seconds even if not currently tethered due to the tether breaking early; this is a bug.
mechanics.quote: the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over 2.5 seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks both the tether and the Null Zone from appearing, but Malzahar still channels.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield prevents both the tether and the Null Zone from appearing, however Malzahar will continue to channel.
